caption: The best shell pasta 🤍 A cozy family dinner that’s toddler-friendly and easy to share. Why we love this meal: • One dinner for the whole family • Soft texture for toddlers • Protein + veggies in one dish • Familiar flavors kids enjoy • No separate cooking Ingredients: • 1 small onion, finely diced • ½ cup shredded carrot • Ground beef • Salt & pepper • Oregano • Paprika • Garlic powder • ½ cup tomato sauce • ½ cup pasta water • Handful spinach, chopped • ¼ cup heavy cream • ½ pack shell pasta, cooked Directions: Sauté onion and carrot until soft. Add ground beef and seasonings and cook through. Stir in tomato sauce and pasta water and let simmer on low. Add spinach and heavy cream, then fold in cooked shell pasta. 👉 For toddlers: chop pasta if needed and keep seasoning light.
